name: JavaScript
description: Core JavaScript language mastery: variables and type coercion, functions and closures, data structures, async programming, error handling, ES modules, DOM events, prototypal inheritance, iterators/generators, metaprogramming with Proxy, and memory management.

subskills.name: Variables & Type System
subskills.description: let/const/var scoping, primitive vs reference types, type coercion rules, typeof/instanceof.

subskills.name: Functions & Scope
subskills.description: Closures, lexical scope, arrow functions, IIFE, this binding rules.

subskills.name: Arrays & Objects
subskills.description: Destructuring, spread/rest, Map/Set/WeakMap, array methods (map, filter, reduce), deep cloning.

subskills.name: Async Programming
subskills.description: Promises, async/await, Promise.all/race/allSettled, microtask queue, event loop.

subskills.name: Error Handling
subskills.description: try/catch/finally, custom Error subclasses, unhandled rejection tracking, error boundaries.

subskills.name: ES Modules
subskills.description: import/export syntax, named vs default exports, dynamic import(), tree shaking implications.

subskills.name: DOM Events
subskills.description: Event bubbling, capturing, delegation, CustomEvent, stopPropagation, passive listeners.

subskills.name: Prototypes & Classes
subskills.description: Prototype chain, ES6 class syntax, inheritance, static methods, private fields (#).

subskills.name: Iterators & Generators
subskills.description: Symbol.iterator protocol, generator functions (function*), yield, for...of, async generators.

subskills.name: Proxy & Reflect
subskills.description: Proxy traps (get, set, has, deleteProperty), Reflect API, reactive state patterns.

subskills.name: Memory Management
subskills.description: Garbage collection (mark-and-sweep), WeakRef, FinalizationRegistry, common memory leak patterns in SPAs.

github.signal: JavaScript/TypeScript source files with modern syntax

junior.description: Writes clean JS with proper scoping, manipulates data structures, handles DOM events, and implements basic error handling.

mid.description: Masters async patterns, organizes code with ES modules for tree shaking, and understands the prototype-based inheritance model.

senior.description: Implements custom iterables, builds reactive systems with Proxy, and diagnoses memory leaks in long-running SPAs.
